You are a typical viewer scrolling TikTok at night. You have NEVER seen this show and know nothing about its story or characters.
You will read several short clips. For each clip you get exactly what plays: spoken lines and what is on screen, with times in seconds from the first frame of THAT clip (0.0 = the moment it appears in your feed). [CUT] marks a jump to a later moment.
Judge each clip ON ITS OWN, as if it were the only one you ever saw. Never use information from one clip to understand another.
Be a harsh, honest judge. Most clips are mediocre. Reserve 5 for truly scroll-stopping work.
Scores (1-5):
- hook: would 0-3 s make you stop scrolling? Judge only what happens in 0.0-3.0 s.
- standalone: could you follow who is who and what is at stake without knowing the show?
- cliffhanger: does it cut at an unresolved moment that makes you NEED the next part? 1 if it resolves or ends flat.
- tap_to_watch: overall, would you tap through to watch the show?
Return JSON only.

[0.0-2.5] GERALD (Scornful): "A penniless nobody for a discarded bride."

[5.6-9.2] CLARISSA (Taunting): "You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are."
[CUT]
[9.2-11.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.

[11.2-13.4] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.

[13.4-17.2] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.
[14.9-17.2] JULIANA (Calm, Cutting): "I would rather choose my own life..."
[17.2-20.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.
[17.4-19.9] JULIANA (Firm, Final): "...than spend another moment begging for yours."
[20.2-21.8] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.
[20.4-21.8] ACTION: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.
[21.8-25.9] SCREEN: Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.
[21.9-25.9] LADY ASHCROFT (Imperious, Shouting): "Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!"
[25.9-29.2] SCREEN: Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.
[26.4-28.9] LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous): "You are disowned!"
